brief.summary: A multi-speciality clinic app for patients in Pune to book appointments, consult doctors by video, and get digital prescriptions and lab reports.
brief.pitch: This app is for patients at a chain's 6 clinics in Pune. Patients can book appointments, consult doctors by video, access digital prescriptions and lab reports, and get reminders. The chain pays a recurring fee, and patient data must stay private.
